Pattern: Forcing the market template (KB/VX/FLOW, convergence matrix, TRADE.md) onto a non-market agent produces dead never-filled files.
Evidence: DARWIN — initialized 2026-02-18, one scan, went cold with empty market-shaped scaffold
Notes: Root cause of the meta-agent blueprint split. Meta/utility agents need a meta-shaped memory instead.

Pattern: Open-ended "watch the whole external landscape" mandates drift and go stale.
Evidence: DARWIN's arxiv/GitHub/HN weekly scan — abandoned after first pass
Notes: Scope external-evolution as an INPUT to a concrete artifact (the blueprint), not a standing patrol.

Pattern: A single maturity ladder mis-scores non-market agents — they lack convergence matrix / TRADE.md by design.
Evidence: NEXUS, TERRY, ORACLE, YEYOU have no market constructs yet are mature for their class
Notes: Per-class rubric (market/utility/meta) sharing an L0-L2 floor. See SPEC.md §5.

Pattern: Permission to edit another agent's files does NOT make it concurrency-safe — a live session clobbers the edit.
Evidence: Root Critical Rule #2; shared .git/index race history (incident 8ac5bf71)
Notes: Require BOTH approval AND idle-target before a cross-agent edit; live agents get task packets.

Pattern: Per-action approval prompts become operator-attention tax at scale.
Evidence: ORCHESTRATION_PLAYBOOK §2 relay discipline — dozens of idle pings flagged as pure tax
Notes: Batch structural fixes into one changelist for a single approval.

Pattern: Two files holding the same fact drift; classification + maturity must not both restate agent state.
Evidence: System cardinal rule (put facts in owner file, reference elsewhere); ROSTER vs FLEET_MAP risk
Notes: FLEET_MAP references ROSTER's active/dormant call; owns only maturity/design state.

Pattern: Missing a required section (e.g. BOTTOM LINE) is a conformance GAP, not a demotion to skeleton level.
Evidence: First scan v1 floored REGINALD (137 KB rows, L4-grade) to L0 for lacking a BOTTOM LINE heading
Notes: Caught in DAEDALUS's own scoring logic. Separate floor (presence) from conformance gaps (debt). Self-dogfood win.

Pattern: Has a structured record must be class-aware — meta/utility records are not market workbook/KB.tsv.
Evidence: Scan v1 floored DAEDALUS to L1 for lacking workbook/KB.tsv despite PATTERNS+FLEET_MAP
Notes: Count any populated top-level .tsv for non-market classes. Same per-class principle as PAT-003.

Pattern: STATUS-only grep misses discipline held in own-titled sections or moved to thesis/ subfiles.
Evidence: HENRY (HEN-NN triggers, 22 pred resolved) + CORAL (rails in thesis/THESIS.md) both flagged false-negative by grep
Notes: Script is a floor+flag generator; judgment must override grep-scope misses for L3+. Confirms SPEC.md §5 hybrid design.

Pattern: Fleet-wide single-section gaps (13 agents missing BOTTOM LINE) are batch-fixable, not per-agent work.
Evidence: First scan: 13/26 agents lack the required BOTTOM LINE
Notes: One changelist + one approval beats 13 task packets. The canonical DAEDALUS maintenance unit (PAT-005 batch principle applied).

Pattern: The fleet has collectively out-designed the original template; no single agent is the whole standard.
Evidence: Full survey: best-of-breed scattered across LIQUID/OTTO/BOND/MARCO/NEXUS/REGINALD — not concentrated in one agent
Notes: Blueprints must be ASSEMBLED best-of-breed, not cloned from one exemplar. Source list in BEST_PRACTICES.md.

Pattern: HENRY's own-titled discipline is strong on falsification/thresholds but WEAK on cross-agent-comparable scoring.
Evidence: Survey: HENRY has no universal 5-pt composite; BOND/BRENT/HAWK do. Will's hunch that others were better was correct.
Notes: Don't crown a pattern off n=1. The "promote HENRY up" idea was right for triad+routing, wrong for scoring — backfill BOND's composite instead.

Pattern: Best falsification pattern in fleet = LIQUID channel-kill-vs-thesis-kill + migration theorem (thesis survives by rerouting).
Evidence: Survey across 23 agents; LIQUID's migration model deeper than HENRY's triad for thesis-persistence
Notes: Anchor every agent's "thesis kill" criteria on channel-migration, not single-channel collapse. Propagate fleet-wide.

Pattern: Best institutional-learning pattern = OTTO PREDICTIONS_ARCHIVE + calibration scoreboard + failure-synthesis fed back to THESIS.
Evidence: Survey; OTTO feeds resolved-prediction post-mortems back as rules gating future predictions
Notes: This is exactly what DAEDALUS's own PATTERNS.tsv does for design. Adopt as prediction-discipline standard.

Pattern: A standard is a FLOOR (required comparable interface), never a CEILING (cap on local expression). Add comparable handles alongside rich local representations; never replace.
Evidence: Will: enforcing the universal 5-pt risked deleting HENRY's CRACKING/RE-ARMED, VIOLET's 45-pt nuance
Notes: Governing principle for ALL blueprints. The 5-pt is a lossy triage projection that ROUTES to the nuance, not substitutes for it. If enforcement deletes valuable context, the enforcement is wrong.

Pattern: The upgrade unit is one-agent-x-one-section, never a whole agent at once. A whole-agent rewrite is an unreviewable giant diff.
Evidence: Will: "the job is too big to upgrade a whole agent in one go -- one section at a time"
Notes: Each blueprint section = one task: read/grade/judge-applies/propose-additive/approve/apply/record. The upgrade card is the work queue. See UPGRADE_PROTOCOL.md.

Pattern: Heavy agents need a durable COMPREHENSION layer (per-agent Profile) built before upgrade work; you can't section-task what you can't hold in context.
Evidence: Will: "almost every agent is gonna be pretty heavy -- build understanding into DAEDALUS." CORAL = STATUS+thesis/+COVERAGE+watchlists+workbook+LESSONS+MEMORY
Notes: Profile = map of the labyrinth (file anatomy, where richness lives, per-dimension local form, do-not-touch). Build heavy ones by fan-out readers -> synthesize. Section-tasks read the profile slice. Flow: comprehend -> decompose -> section-tasks.

Pattern: A new agent in an open-ended domain (climate, "the landscape") must bake its anti-drift guard into its STRUCTURE, not its prose. Scope to a fixed set of concrete transmission channels (event->mechanism->repricing) where an EMPTY channel reads as a failure signal, not idle background.
Evidence: AEOLUS build (climate->economy). Directly inverts the DARWIN failure (PAT-001/002): "watch all weather" drifts; "keep these 3 channels live" cannot.
Notes: The DARWIN antidote operationalized. For any broad-domain build: define 3-5 channels, make each carry a live read, make emptiness a gap. New channels added deliberately (tier-2->core promotion), never by drift. Pair with tiered horizon (live signal layer over slow structural backdrop).

Pattern: A brand-new agent has no commit history, so ROSTER's commit-activity classifier can't place it. List ACTIVE-by-intent with an explicit "new, reconcile next pass" annotation rather than forcing a false commit count or hiding it.
Evidence: AEOLUS wired into ROSTER 6/28 with 0 commits; ROSTER methodology is 30/60d git-activity based.
Notes: Build-wiring and activity-classification are different clocks. Annotate the gap honestly; let the next activity pass reconcile. Don't fabricate a cadence number to satisfy a table.
